audit.whatIsWrong: Frost Armor is repeatedly labelled '(E)' and Permafrost is described as a slow. Both are wrong: Frost Armor is her passive (Fury of the North), Winter's Wrath (W) is the slow that applies Frost stacks, and Permafrost (E) is a stun that only fires on a target at maximum Frost stacks.
audit.why: The page told the player to fear a slow and ignore the actual stun setup, and mislabelled her passive as an ability slot.
audit.corrected: Frost Armor named as the passive that fades once you keep damage on her; the W-stacks-into-E-stun sequence stated with Permafrost's 1.5s cooldown as the reason you must not eat a full Winter's Wrath.
sources: Sejuani kit P / W / E text

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing said what Glacial Prison does to Infinite Duress.
audit.why: Warwick's R is flagged as a channel and the already-audited mirror teaches Sejuani to hold her stun for it — so from this side the ordering rule is the whole level-6 fight: bait the stun first, then ult.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text now states that Glacial Prison cancels Infinite Duress mid-suppress and gives the ordering.

audit.whatIsWrong: The packet chart (Warwick 4 / Skill 3) and the already-audited sejuani__warwick mirror (Sejuani 5 / Skill 2) are direct opposites, and Warwick wins 52.33% over 300 games.
audit.why: Either chart could be defended, and picking one silently would ship a contradiction the mirror tool would then overwrite. Per the no-guessing rule I left every side/rating row untouched and raised it as a question.
Spike stages are right: her level 6 and Warwick's first bruiser item. The item spike text now also states the prerequisite her stun needs, so the player knows why the duel flips.

edits.before: Her Frost Armor and Permafrost slow make the 4-5 trade a wash.
edits.after: Winter's Wrath slows and Permafrost stuns off it, so 4-5 is a wash.

edits.before: Sejuani is a tank with weak lane damage — with Q Jaws sustain and Blood Hunt you out-DPS her Arctic Assault (Q) and can shove and threaten before her Frost Armor (E) stacks matter.
edits.after: Sejuani is a tank with weak lane damage — Jaws of the Beast sustain plus Blood Hunt out-DPS her, and Frost Armor (Passive) fades once you keep damage on her, so shove and threaten early.

edits.before: Her Glacial Prison (R) is a skillshot stun; if she lands it first she can lock your combo, so bait it — this is the even, skill-check window.
edits.after: Glacial Prison (R) is a skillshot stun and it cancels Infinite Duress mid-suppress — bait it out first, then ult, never the reverse.

edits.before: Once you have a bruiser item your sustained damage beats her tank stats one-v-one; her E Permafrost slow just tickles and she can't kill you.
edits.after: Once you have a bruiser item your sustained damage beats her tank stats one-v-one; she needs Winter's Wrath stacks before Permafrost can stun.

edits.before: Levels 2-5 are a mix: at 3 you shove and out-DPS her tanky-but-toothless kit, but her Frost Armor (E) and Permafrost slow plus her impending R make the 4-5 window a skill check. Don't walk into a point-blank Glacial Prison.
edits.after: Levels 2-5 are a mix: at 3 you shove and out-DPS her tanky-but-toothless kit, but Winter's Wrath (W) stacks Frost and Permafrost (E) stuns off it on a 1.5s cooldown, so 4-5 is a skill check. Never eat a full W into E.

edits.before: Stack Frost Armor (E) and slow you with Permafrost
edits.after: Stack Frost with Winter's Wrath, then Permafrost you
